title: Jobs SHZ Scraper
description: Collect public vacancies from Jobs SHZ (jobs.shz.de), the Schleswig-Holstein job board reached through jobs.sh.

searchQuery.title: Job search query
searchQuery.description: Keyword search sent to Jobs SHZ, for example 'Pflegefachkraft' or 'Softwareentwickler'. The site matches its public vacancy index and accepts German job terms. Leave blank to collect the newest listings across the board. This is not a URL or an applicant name.

startUrls.title: Specific Jobs SHZ URLs
startUrls.description: Optional public Jobs SHZ search or job-detail URLs to collect, for example 'https://jobs.shz.de/jobs?search=Pflege'. The actor uses these instead of Job search query when provided. Up to 20 URLs are accepted. Do not provide login, applicant, or employer-admin pages.

maxResults.title: Maximum vacancies
maxResults.description: Maximum number of validated vacancy records to return. Enter an integer from 1 to 200; the default is 20. The per-vacancy event charges stop at this cap, keeping event costs bounded. This is not a page count.

includeJobDetails.title: Include full job details
includeJobDetails.description: Whether to open each public vacancy page for its description and additional fields. Keep enabled for recruitment research and detailed records. Default is true; disabling it returns listing-level fields faster. This does not access private applicant data.

responseFormat.title: Response format
responseFormat.description: Controls the maximum public description length in every dataset record. Choose 'concise' for short agent-friendly records or 'detailed' for up to 8,000 characters of job text. Defaults to concise. This does not translate or summarize the original German content.

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
